profile_text.body:
Digital Realty Trust, Inc., which also goes by Digital Realty, is a public company headquartered in Austin, Texas, and traded under the ticker DLR. Its site describes a global data center platform offering colocation, interconnection, connectivity and cloud services, with deployments ranging from single racks to private suites and high-density AI workflows. The company says it is sustainably built for flexibility, open ecosystems and reach.

On AI, the site frames infrastructure as the constraint: it says inference loads and GPU demands are pushing traditional environments to their limits, and that AI is evolving faster than infrastructure can lag behind. It cites its 2026 Global Data Insights Survey, which it says found that 40% of IT leaders cite infrastructure as an AI constraint, and describes enterprises moving from AI strategy to execution.

The company's record shows no tracked AI products, no MCP servers and no lawsuits. It has a registered presence in Texas, with 126 recorded items of legal exposure there.
